programme.desc: S2 E35 — CafeIn the park, Bluey meets a new playmate, Winnie, but when Bluey wants to invite her and her dad home for breakfast, she learns that adults take a little bit longer to make friends.

programme.title: MaeBee
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Mae, Bee and the Bearded BakeWhile helping at Lesley's bakery, Mae, Bee and friends eat some magical buns of ageing that turn them 500 years old! A rare four-leaf clover is the only cure - that's if they can catch it!

programme.title: Tralala
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Sick of Being SickTralala is stuck at home sick, but Batty won't give up trying to play with her.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: The Cherry Tree WishRuby and Finn's seeds have started to grow, but Rafi's cherry seed shows no change. Feeling left out, she makes a wish, and a giant cherry tree appears! It's exciting at first, but when the wish ends, everything disappears. Rafi feels sad, until Doris shares a story about planting an apple tree when she was little. Rafi realises that nature likes to take its time, and that waiting can bring something special.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: S2 E5 — Owl's First FlightThe caravan is visited by a little owl learning to fly. The owl and Alva, Nick's granddaughter, give Nick the perfect idea for the song of the day.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Tidy Up DayIt's Tidy Up Day, so everyone in Fluffytown is tidying things. Love Monster helps Book Cub to clean up the forest, and as he does so, finds several items that would make great souvenirs. These include a bunny-shaped rock and a heart-shaped stone.

programme.title: Knee High Spies
programme.desc: S1 E20 — Mission Hooray for HolidaysThe spies are excited to go on a family holiday, but Silver Paw tries to ruin it by turning off Dad's early morning alarm. To save the trip, Jeremy sneaks out of the suitcase for a solo mission.

programme.title: Dylan's Playtime Adventures
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Dylan the Astronaut on a MissionDylan the Space Commander is determined to protect the planets. However, when one of Saturn's rings unexpectedly falls off, it becomes clear that the entire crew will need to work together to set things right.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: S1 E16 — Flappy SnapCherry wants to photograph a rare and shy butterfly. The Piggy Builders are eager to help, but they get so competitive that they scare it away. Cherry is heartbroken. To fix their mistake, they will have to work together.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: S1 E38 — Cleo NibblesA famous soul singer is coming to perform in the garden, but no one knows what they look like. Meanwhile, a cheeky little mouse with a great big voice has appeared in the sun house.

programme.title: Magic Hands
programme.desc: S2 E2 — The Pied PiperAimee and Ashley discover 'The Pied Piper of Hamelin', by Robert Browning.

programme.title: Nikhil and Jay
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Nikhil and Jay and the Deepavali FireworksNikhil, Jay and their family celebrate Deepavali, also known as Diwali, with kolam, laddus and bunting. They try to watch the fireworks without scaring Max the cat.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E36 — PostmanWhen Mum and Dad have a disagreement, Bluey makes Dad write a love letter to Mum to make up. Now Bluey must find a way to deliver the letter to Mum.

programme.title: Andy and the Band
programme.desc: S2 E2 — Dinosaur FootballRockers Leo and Jimi are unfairly locked in detention by their strict headteacher and will miss their first ever gig unless the band can bust them out. It's time for a crazy plan.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: S2 — Autumn: It's Time to Celebrate DiwaliJoJo and Gran Gran celebrate Diwali, the festival of light, with their friends Raya and Nirada. It's a very exciting celebration, with lots of yummy food, diyas, music and, of course, lights. Raya teaches JoJo how to make a rangoli. And when Raya doesn't like the loud sounds coming from the fireworks, JoJo has a plan to help her friend.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: S1 E4 — The Shiny ShellBaba finds a beautiful, shiny shell that causes some seagull trouble for Oona.

programme.title: Charlie and Lola
programme.desc: S1 E11 — Boo! Made You Jump!It's ever so easy for Charlie to make Lola jump. What Lola wants more than anything is to make Charlie jump, but this proves quite tricky.

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: S2 E9 — A Hole in the Road!Mr Onion is riding on the Bumparoller when he discovers a great big hole in the road. What are we going to do? Mr Onion knows how to fix it.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: S1 E46 — FullMemo and Baba find fun ways to play as they fill up and empty different containers.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: S1 E53 — Igglepiggle's TiddleA mysterious jet of water, a tiddle, appears suddenly next to Igglepiggle. He discovers that he can control it by stamping his feet. Delighted, he takes it to Makka Pakka who finds it very useful indeed.

programme.title: Cbeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: S2018 E33 — Katinka's TailAn exciting story read by a special guest. Annette Badland reads 'Katinka's Tail' by Judith Kerr, a story about a pussycat with an extraordinary tail.

programme.title: A Wild Year
programme.desc: S1 E1 — The Pembrokeshire CoastIn the far south-west corner of Wales lies Pembrokeshire's wild and rugged coast. Twisting and turning along the edge of the Atlantic, life on this ancient coastline is defined by the rhythm of the seasons and the power of the sea. Fishing these fertile waters has long been a tradition here. Every day, local fisherman Jono Voyce heads out from Solva harbour into St Brides Bay to fish for the lobster and crab he supplies to these coastal communities.

programme.title: Secret Knowledge
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Bolsover CastleLucy Worsley tells the story of Bolsover Castle in Derbyshire. Built in the early 17th century, Bolsover Castle became the pleasure palace of playboy Cavalier and ambitious courtier William Cavendish.

programme.title: War Grave
programme.desc: Intimate and moving stories of loss and remembrance are told by friends and relatives of those killed in some of the major conflicts of the 20th century, from the First World War to the Falklands.

programme.title: Playing the Dane
programme.desc: Stars of theatre, television and film, including Jeremy Brett, Steven Berkoff, Richard Briers, Christopher Plummer, Ian McKellen and Christopher Walken, describe the challenge of playing Shakespeare's Hamlet.

programme.title: Steven Berkoff Remembers... Hamlet at Elsinore
programme.desc: Steven Berkoff remembers one of his earliest screen roles, as a junior player in 'Hamlet at Elsinore', a BBC co-production with Danish television that starred Christopher Plummer as the prince.

programme.title: BBC Television Shakespeare
programme.desc: Hamlet at ElsinoreA 1964 production of William Shakespeare's famous tragedy. Filmed in Elsinore, Denmark.

programme.title: A Ghost Story for Christmas
programme.desc: Count MagnusSweden, 1863. A country not much visited by Englishmen. An exception is the inquisitive Mr Wraxhall, whose innocent rummaging through the archives of the noble de la Gardie family takes a sinister turn.

programme.title: A Ghost Story for Christmas
programme.desc: The Mezzotint1923. In the heart of an old English college, Edward Williams receives an engraving of an unknown country house with an imposing facade, a sweeping lawn - and, just perhaps, something else.

programme.title: A Ghost Story for Christmas
programme.desc: Martin's CloseAdaptation of a ghost story by MR James. 1684. John Martin is on trial for his life. Facing him, the infamous 'hanging judge' George Jeffreys. However, this is not a cut-and-dried murder case.

programme.title: A Ghost Story for Christmas
programme.desc: The Dead RoomAubrey Judd, veteran radio presenter of 'The Dead Room', soon realises that elements of his own past are not as dead and buried as he perhaps hoped.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S1 E12 — Bumps!The Teletubbies have fun bumping into one another and watch the children in Tummy Tales play in bumper cars.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: S1 E37 — PianoMo loves playing the piano, and Tee wants to help Mo play the piano too. This could lead to some interesting music!

programme.title: Colourblocks

programme.title: Bluey Minisodes
programme.desc: S1 E7 — AnimalsMum plays the animal game on Bingo's back. She pretends Bingo's back is a big field and various animals walk, jump and dart across it, making Bingo laugh.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S2 E4 — VaccinationIt's vaccination day! Bing knows it might hurt a little, but he is looking forward to the special shiny Hoppity Voosh sticker he will get from Doctor Molly. Bing is brave, but when he goes to get his sticker after his vaccination, he finds out that there are none left! Bing is upset, but then Pando mistakes Bing's disappointment for pain, and Doctor Bing has to help.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Pig Gets BigFarmer Jackson was just trying to grow some giant tomatoes, but he wound up with a giant pig! Now Mojo and Bo have to get Felix back to normal size before Swoppiton gets stomped.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S4 E17 — The Dream BadgeThe Squirrels are at the Clubhouse playing, but they can't stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Luckily, Duggee has his dream badge and can help the Squirrels work out what they mean. As the Squirrels think about dreams, all the different dreams of the Clubhouse friends become weirder and more wonderful. We even get to see Duggee's dream.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S4 E18 — The Eating BadgeThe Squirrels are having a picnic and notice that the chickens eat differently than they do. Duggee has his eating badge and can explain all the different ways animals eat. Some animals eat slowly like cows, who eat all day long. But others eat quickly like frogs. Some, like goats, are always eating, while tortoises can go a whole year without food. Some animals eat food that is very high up, like giraffes, and some eat food that is very low down, like moles.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E2 — BedroomBluey is excited to get her own room, but when bedtime comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E37 — The Quiet GameBluey and Bingo are playing The Quiet Game and won't use words to tell Dad which toy to buy. At his wits end, Dad recruits new store clerk Alfie to help interpret the miming.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: S3 E36 — The Blarney Stone, IrelandGlitch finally pushes the Grimbots too far with his rudeness, prompting them to go on strike. Glitch seeks help from Kyan, but Kyan has his own problems, as he's worried about speaking in front of a crowd for his upcoming show and tell. A solution to both their problems occurs to Glitch: they'll travel to Blarney Castle in Ireland, near where his Great Aunt Cliodhna lived, and find the Blarney Stone. It is said to give the gift of the gab to all who kiss it, making them brilliant at talking.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S2 — The Tale of the Terrible TrapTired of being constantly humiliated, the predators devise a plan that will get rid of that pesky Peter Rabbit once and for all... if they can work together long enough to pull it off!

programme.desc: As the season ends, the Dirt Dogs must deliver $233,000 of gold to hit the target. Alex faces a shock resignation, and the Gold Gypsies struggle with more gold thieves.

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: The Dirt Dogs invest in a hard rock mining plant. And, the Gold Gypsies are eager to be back in the field, but a $20,000 excavator repair is a tough start to the season.

programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters
programme.desc: The Bushmen risk their lives in the fight to get their one-tonne digger down a 20-metre deep mine shaft. Plus, new alliances are forged as the Boulder Boys hit pay dirt.

programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters
programme.desc: The Bushmen dodge rockfalls in a potentially deadly new mine. The Fire Crew close in on a new deposit of black opal and the Boulder Boys struggle to drain their pit.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: In Dorset, Drew visits a showroom full of mid-20th century items, including a pair of 1960s Danish leather chairs. And, he visits an Austin Healey and Porsche classic car restorer.

programme.title: Shed And Buried: Classic Cars

programme.desc: Italy v South AfricaItaly v South Africa (Kick-off 11.40am). Jill Douglas presents all the action from both teams' opening match of the Northern Hemsiphere Series, held at Allianz Stadium in Turin. World champions South Africa currently sit top of the Southern Hemisphere table with three wins from three, while Italy are bottom of the Northern table after three defeats, but will hope they can be competitive in front of their own fans. With analysis from John Barclay and Greig Laidlaw, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Tom Shanklin.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: S1 E21 — Scotland v New ZealandScotland v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Jill Douglas presents all the action from the match at Scottish Gas Murrayfield. With analysis from John Barclay, Greig Laidlaw and Sean Fitzpatrick, commentary by Miles Harrison and Johnnie Beattie, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Wales v JapanWales v Japan (Kick-off 4.40pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the match at Principality Stadium. Both teams won just one match of three in the Southern Hemisphere series and will be looking to impress this evening. The last time the nations met was in Wales' 2025 tour of Japan, when the teams won one match apiece. With analysis from Dan Biggar and Sam Warburton, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams and Jamie Roberts.

Meanwhile, with the pigs gone, the family begin transforming the old pig field into a vegetable patch.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure

Then, he pays a visit to seafood restaurant The Dock House in Sag Harbour, where he samples their famous chowder.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered

programme.desc: E3In 2008, nearly 850 people are killed in the Russo-Georgian War. How did it erupt and what is the current relationship between the two nations?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E5A Greenpeace ship is bombed in 1985, killing Fernando Pereira. The French authorities deny responsibility and questions over nuclear restrictions arise again.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E6In 1979, Maurice Bishop takes control of Grenada. Four years later, he is assassinated. Is this another case of the US using its might to stop Communism?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E7From 1969 to 1973, US forces bomb Cambodia and the country falls into a brutal form of communism. Did the US' involvement pave the way for Pol Pot's regime?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E8After the Cuban revolution, Fidel Castro looked to exert his influence in Venezuela. Is Cuba still in charge of Venezuela's future?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E9In 1989, 20,000 US troops entered Panama to overthrow military dictator Manuel Noriega and around 500 civilians were killed. What prompted the invasion?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E10How will the new Cold War, involving the US, Russia, the UK and China, play out? Will trade and cyber warfare be the worst of it or is military war inevitable?

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E1Viking combat ships changed the course of history. Their longships brought William the Conqueror’s troops to Hastings, adventurers to North America and raiders to plunder the Saxon kingdoms.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E2In Stealth we examine the methods ships have used to evade detection. With the advent of radar in WW2, ships that wanted to remain undetected had to find ways to hide.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E3Explore the design flaws and human errors that condemned great ships to a tragic end. In 1628 the warship Vasa sank on her maiden voyage. Together with Vasa curator Fred Hocker, solve the mystery of why this great ship sank.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E4Destroyers and Cruisers showcases ships that with their speed and firepower became the backbones of 20th century navies. We tell the incredible story of USS Laffey, the WW2 destroyer that would come to be known as ‘the ship that would not die’.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E5This episode tells stories about the secret world of naval deception and cloak and dagger missions. 1914, the yacht Asgard, manned by Erskine Childers, smuggled rifles into a fishing village to arm an Irish militia in their struggle for Home Rule.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E6The 16th century witnessed a revolution in combat ship design and saw the birth of two legendary sea captains; Sir John Hawkins and Sir Francis Drake – both superb seamen and adventurers who would have a lasting impact on naval history.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E7The Battle of Leyte Gulf tells the story of the largest sea conflict in history involving Pearl Harbor warships and the largest battleships in the world, and how the US Navy, despite kamikaze attacks and a Japanese decoy fleet, were victorious.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E8In this episode we look at vessels built for amphibious combat. We begin by looking at the last reaming Landing Craft Tank (LCT) to serve on D-Day – LCT 7074. These huge landing craft were essential in delivering tanks, trucks, soldiers and supplies.
